title: 第9章 真相第10章 天炎联盟
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【模拟结束，综合评分：325】
【你一生都在刻苦修炼，经过家族的支持后提升了根骨，以你的天资，本可以引领叶家的一个时代走向辉煌，但最终却因为福地变故导致整个叶家被灭族。
而以穿越者的身份来说，你是一个倒霉的穿越之耻。
【请从以下选项中选择奖励。
【选项一：境界提升一重，消耗8积分，可重复选择，随着境界不同消耗积分不同。
【选项二：憾山拳提升至融会贯通，消耗50积分，可重复选择。
【选项三：获得黄级中品武技‘蜉蝣踏前斩’入门级，消耗1积分，可重复选择。
【选项四：获得永久性天赋‘天生药心’，消耗积分50。
【选项五：提升天赋‘天生双魂’，消耗积分230。
【选项六：提升根骨至凡级中品，消耗积分30。
【选项七:获取第二次模拟的记忆，消耗积分30。
（记忆以类似电影模式获得，获取记忆不需要积分，积分用于保护神魂，避免大量信息涌入受到损害）】
看着可选择的奖励，叶枫哈喇子都要流出来了，这些奖励他都想要。
叶枫犹豫了良久，最终还是作下了决定，选择了‘天生药心’，把根骨从凡级下品提升至黄级下品。
境界从淬体境六重提升至淬体境九重。
憾山拳提升至融会贯通，记忆肯定必选，剩余的积分已经无法选择除蜉蝣踏前斩之外的其他几项了。
算了，反正之后还有机会，‘天生双魂’迟早还是可以升级的，
最后还剩余5积分，叶枫不打算把这个积分用来获取蜉蝣踏前斩的入门级，用在入门级的武技上总觉得浪费，看看下次能否带给自己一个临时天赋。
【购买完毕，剩余5积分可用于下次模拟抽取天赋。
姓名：叶枫
种族：人族
content_en:
[Simulation ends, overall score: 325]
[You have been practicing hard all your life, and with the support of your family, you have improved your foundation. With your talent, you could have led the Ye family to glory in an era, but in the end, the entire Ye family was wiped out due to changes in the blessed land.
And as a time traveler, you are an unlucky person who is a disgrace to time travel.
[Please select a reward from the options below.
[Option 1: To raise the realm by one level, it consumes 8 points. It can be selected repeatedly. The points consumed vary with the realm.
[Option 2: Upgrade Mount Mountain Fist to Comprehensive Mastery, which consumes 50 points and can be selected repeatedly.
[Option 3: Obtain the entry-level yellow-level mid-level martial skill ‘Mayfly Stomp’, which consumes 1 point and can be selected repeatedly.
[Option 4: Obtain the permanent talent ‘Natural Medicine Heart’, which consumes 50 points.
[Option 5: Improve the talent ‘Born with Two Souls’, which consumes 230 points.
[Option 6: Upgrade the root bone to the mid-level mortal level, which consumes 30 points.
[Option 7: Obtain the memory of the second simulation, which consumes 30 points.
(Memories are obtained in a movie-like mode. Points are not required to obtain memories. Points are used to protect the soul and avoid damage due to the influx of information)]
Looking at the optional rewards, Ye Feng was so excited that he wanted all of them.
Ye Feng hesitated for a long time, but finally made a decision and chose the 'Innate Medicine Heart' to upgrade the root bone from a low-grade mortal level to a low-grade yellow level.
The realm has been upgraded from the sixth level of the Body Tempering Realm to the ninth level of the Body Tempering Realm.
When the Han Shan Quan is upgraded to the level of mastery, the memory must be selected. The remaining points cannot be used to choose other items except the Mayfly Stepping Forward Slash.
Forget it, there will still be opportunities in the future anyway, and the ‘Born with Two Souls’ can still be upgraded sooner or later.
In the end, there were still 5 points left. Ye Feng did not intend to use these points to obtain the entry-level skill of Mayfly Stomping. It always felt like a waste to use it on entry-level martial arts. Let's see if he could give himself a temporary talent next time.
[After the purchase is completed, the remaining 5 points can be used for the next simulation to draw talents.
Name: Ye Feng
Race: Human race
Lifespan: 8120
